title: South Sudan cattle battles leaves 10 dead: official
titleRu: В результате боёв скота в Южном Судане погибли 10 человек: официальный представитель
summary: JUBA: New armed raids by cattle rustlers in a troubled South Sudan state have left at least 10 people dead, local authorities said Saturday. Clashes over stolen cattle also left three wounded in Tonji North county of Warrap state on Friday evening, according to local commissioner Agany Lok Agany. “The incident is connected with a series of revenge and cattle raiding activities,” the official added.
